title: kit.json
description: Per-project config read by the portable dev kit: githooks gates (scripts/kit/*) and the global bash-destructive-guard hook. Location: .claude/kit.json (preferred) or kit.json at the repo root. Every field is optional; a missing field means the matching gate is skipped (protectedBranches falls back to main/master).

commands.description: Project commands. Informational for agents (CLAUDE.md section 2.5 refers to them) and defaults for the gates. lint is the default ratchet lint command per workspace; p0 is run by the pre-commit p0 module.

p0.description: Fast regression command run at pre-commit when modules.p0 is true. Empty = skipped.

protectedBranches.description: Branches that cannot be committed to or pushed to directly. Default: [main, master].

prHost.description: Where PRs live. github = use gh; bitbucket = gh does not apply, PR skills translate via git (see git-gh-ops). Default: github.

baseRef.description: Ref the diff-scoped pre-push gates compare against. Default: origin/main (falls back to HEAD~1 if absent).

destructiveGuard.description: Read by the global bash-destructive-guard hook (playbook). Must stay aligned with that hook.

allowPaths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes whose contents are disposable: rm inside them is not blocked. '..' traversal, node_modules and unresolvable targets stay blocked.

secretScan.description: Staged-diff secret scan (always on). Extra exclusions beyond the built-ins (*.env.example, the hook itself, SECURITY_ROTATION_SOP.md).

review.description: Read by feature-pipeline / code-review (dev/feature-pipeline/door-check.sh) to classify a PR as a one-way or two-way door.

oneWayDoorPaths.description: Extra ERE regexes on repo-relative paths that make a diff a one-way door, added to the built-in defaults in door-check.sh (migrations, schema, tax, payments, auth/RBAC, XML generators, outbound notifications, secrets, deploy). Use for project-specific calculation / compliance code, e.g. "(^|/)modules/orders/pricing/".

modules.description: Optional gate switches. Unset defaults: envDrift, dependencyPins, emojiScan = true (each self-skips when it has no input files); lintRatchet, tscRatchet, ponytailAck, p0 = false.

envDrift.description: pre-commit: block .env keys missing from .env.example. Runs only if a tracked .env.example exists.

dependencyPins.description: pre-commit: block bumping a pinned dependency. Runs only when package.json is staged and the pin file exists.

emojiScan.description: pre-commit: R1 no-emoji scan on staged source files.

lintRatchet.description: pre-push: lint count must not exceed baseline. Needs ratchet.lint.workspaces.

tscRatchet.description: pre-push: tsc error count must not exceed baseline. Needs ratchet.tsc.workspaces.

ponytailAck.description: pre-push: code diffs need PONYTAIL_REVIEWED=1 (semi-blocking over-engineering review).

p0.description: pre-commit: run commands.p0 (skipped for docs-only commits).

codeExtensions.description: File extensions (no dot) whose changes need /ponytail-review before push when modules.ponytailAck is on. Default: ts, tsx, js, jsx. A Python project: ["py"].

workspaces.description: Directories to lint. '.' = repo root. A string is shorthand for { path }.

command.description: Run inside path; must print an ESLint stylish summary ('N problems (E errors, W warnings)'). Default: commands.lint, else 'npm run --silent lint'.

project.description: tsconfig passed to tsc -p. Default tsconfig.json.

excludePrefixes.description: Extra repo-relative path prefixes to skip (built-in: dev-rule/, .planning/, docs/, .claude/, .githooks/).
